authorization.interpretation: The controller may select evidence-separated reusable repairs. This is not represented as a human reply to either change bundle and does not authorize formal-target integration.

external_comparison.basis: The curated corpus has the official 2025 C problem and attachment but no applicable 2025 C answer or expert commentary; available 2025 B materials are out of scope and were not used to score the frozen C result.

approved_bundles.title: Input-population reconciliation gate
approved_bundles.decision_relevance: Prevents silent parser/filter loss from reaching model fitting or being presented as a successful comparable run.
approved_bundles.reusable_contract_gap: R2 has no mandatory audited-to-used row/entity reconciliation with authorized exclusion reasons and main/baseline population parity.

prospective_behavior_test.fail: Audited input loses observations or entities without reconciled, prospectively authorized reasons, or main and baseline populations differ without approved semantics.
prospective_behavior_test.pass: Audited, parsed, excluded, eligible and used row/entity counts reconcile exactly and any intentional population difference is declared by the approved method contract.

approved_bundles.title: Hard operating-constraint and abstention/triage guardrail
approved_bundles.decision_relevance: Prevents a classification operating claim from surviving unstable split evidence or ambiguous abstention accounting.
approved_bundles.reusable_contract_gap: R2 does not explicitly require nested group-safe threshold calibration, cross-split rechecking of a hard operating constraint, identical main/baseline action semantics, and visible abstention coverage.

prospective_behavior_test.fail: Threshold selection reads outer-test labels, repeated entities cross partitions, abstentions count as negatives, deferral is hidden, or main/baseline action contracts differ.
prospective_behavior_test.pass: Threshold calibration is nested and group-safe, the supplied operating constraint is checked under predeclared perturbations, and identical action/metric semantics expose coverage and deferral.
